findings.title: Mixed assignment regimes can be mislabeled as causal
findings.what: AxisAccum stores one assignment value, initialized from the first usable enrollment. Later sessions on the same axis contribute metrics without checking or combining their assignment regime. At src/lib/experiments/evaluator.ts:204, a first blind enrollment therefore makes an axis containing later self-selected menu sessions report confidence='causal' and omit the self-selection caveat. Map insertion order can consequently change the claim without changing the observations.
findings.fix: Track assignment regimes for every contributing session. Report causal confidence only when all contributing sessions are blind; otherwise report observational confidence and retain the menu-assignment caveat (or reject/split mixed regimes).
findings.acceptance: Add a unit case with at least one blind and one menu enrollment for the same axis, placing blind first and menu first in separate runs; both results must remain observational with the self-selection caveat, or mixed regimes must be deterministically rejected/split.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial second pass re-read the accumulator initialization and confidence projection at baseline lines 177-207 and the ledger's accepted assignment values. No later consistency check exists; later mixed-regime metrics are appended while the first assignment remains authoritative.
